description: This file is a C header defining exported API functions for the Sys Rro Hcxt Object, including creation, removal, and initialization functions, along with licensing information and module descriptions.

methods.name: SysCreateRroHcxt
methods.description: Creates a new Rro Hcxt object with given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SysRroHcxtCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Sys Rro Hcxt object with specified contexts.

methods.name: SysRroHcxtRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified Rro Hcxt object.

methods.name: SysRroHcxtEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects for Rro Hcxt operation.
